otherwise.does: A threshold: a number found in the specification or declared with `around`.
An input is to be picked from what the component remembers: at the position `pick`, or not at all when there is none. No remembered value has been given yet.
The candidates for a number input are decided next: whether it takes integers only, and its smallest and largest value if it has them. No threshold has been given yet.
The candidates for a string input are decided next. Nothing has been given yet.

The answer: the position (among all the values given, from 0) of the value picked, or null. Among the values that can be used, the one at `pick` modulo their number is picked; none is picked when there is no `pick` or no value can be used.

The answer. The limits: the smallest and then the largest value, those that exist. The thresholds: for each threshold (taking a threshold given twice once), the threshold itself, or, for an input that takes integers only, one less, itself and one more. Both keep only values the input takes (an integer if it takes integers only, within its smallest and largest value), each once, in the order first found.
The answer: the strings given (each once, in the order first given) and the lengths decided (each once, in the order first decided).

behaviors.description: A remembered value, and whether it can be used (it is not null and fits the input's type).
behaviors.name: Item

behaviors.description: A number found in the specification. If it is an integer from 1 to 10000, strings one shorter, of that length and one longer are to be tried (those lengths, in that order: the number minus one, the number, the number plus one; each kept once).
behaviors.name: LengthNumber

otherwise.does: A string found in the specification, or an example declared for the input.

descriptions.component: Decides which values the generator of command inputs mixes in, and which remembered value an input is picked from.
descriptions.data.aroundValues: The thresholds given so far for a number input, in the order given.
descriptions.data.foundLengths: The lengths decided so far for a string input, each once, in the order first decided.
descriptions.data.highest: The largest value the number input takes, if any.
descriptions.data.itemsGiven: How many remembered values have been given so far.
descriptions.data.knownTexts: The strings given so far for a string input, each once, in the order first given.
descriptions.data.lowest: The smallest value the number input takes, if any.
descriptions.data.pickGiven: The position to pick, if one is to be picked.
descriptions.data.usablePositions: The positions (from 0) of the remembered values given so far that can be used.
descriptions.data.wholeOnly: Whether the number input takes integers only.

itemsAfter.description: The number of values given so far, plus one

lengthsWithNew.description: The lengths decided so far, followed by the number minus one, the number and the number plus one, in that order, each unless it is already there

limits.description: The smallest and then the largest value, those that exist, keeping only values the input takes, each once

picked.description: null without pick or without any usable value; otherwise the usable position at pick modulo the number of usable positions

positionsWithItem.description: The usable positions so far, followed by the position of this value (the number of values given before it)

textsWithNew.description: The strings given so far, followed by the string unless it was already given

thresholds.description: For each threshold given (a threshold given twice taken once), the threshold, or one less, itself and one more for an input that takes integers only; keeping only values the input takes, each once, in the order first found

thresholdsWithNew.description: The thresholds given so far, followed by the threshold
